title: The restart-resume test for exit_failed_held positions mocks the SQL that is the S-1 fix and never checks which dex or amount the position is resumed with, so the S-1 regression and the registered wrong-dex and wrong-probe defects all pass it

evidence.note: getResumeExitMonitorTrades and getResumeAntiRugTrades are vi.fn statements; the rows are injected by each test
Test A asserts call[2] (token) and call[5] (tradeId) only; call[1] (dex) and call[4] (amount) are never checked
the fixture chain has exactly one V2 and one V3 dex, so "first dex of the pool type" is always the right one
getResumeExitMonitorTrades: the union that re-adds exit_failed_held rows (the S-1 fix) is never executed by a unit test
resume picks ctx.chain.dexes.find(isDexV3 / isDexV2) and passes ctx.chain.snipeAmount (AUD-EXIT-013, AUD-EXIT-015)

sibling_sites_checked: git grep getResumeExitMonitorTrades / getResumeAntiRugTrades over test/unit at the base SHA: only the bot/ tests that mock db.ts reference them; db.test.ts and db/exitFailedHeldMigration.test.ts never run these two statements. Integration tests that reference them (botWiring, midRunWalletCheck, pauseFlow, preflightInvocation) are TESTI scope (22-24).
severity_rationale: S2: the test claims the restart re-protects failed-held positions (an S1 stranded-position fix) while the SQL that does it is mocked; the registered S1s AUD-EXIT-013, AUD-ANTIRUG-011 and AUD-EXIT-015 are invisible to its assertions.
recommendation: Phase 28: run the real getResumeExitMonitorTrades / getResumeAntiRugTrades against a temp DB seeded with a failed-held row, a pending row and a sold row, and assert the dex (by router address) and the probe amount each resumed position gets on a chain with two V2 dexes.
affected_cases: Test A (re-monitor): an exit_failed_held row (trades.status=failed) with balanceOf>0 is RE-ENTERED into exit monitoring on restart
Test B (re-register anti-rug): the same exit_failed_held position has its anti-rug RE-REGISTERED on restart
Test D (no regression — exit monitor): a normal status=pending buy with NO exit_state resumes exactly as before
Test D (no regression — anti-rug): a normal status=pending buy is re-registered exactly as before, and a closed/sold one is not in the scan
escaped_regression: Change getResumeExitMonitorTrades at src/utils/db.ts:597 back to WHERE status = 'pending' AND action = 'buy' (the S-1 bug that dropped failed-held positions on reboot): every case stays green because the statement is mocked. Also green today: resuming a position bought on the second V2 dex through the first one (src/bot.ts:1950) and with the current snipe amount (:1955).
